title: Posets and Möbius Inversion
key_idea: I-E on the Boolean lattice generalizes to Möbius inversion on any locally finite poset. The Möbius function $\mu(x,y)$ of a poset is defined recursively and generalizes $(-1)^{|T|-|S|}$.
